Remediation: rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was never healthy in production; the most recent healthy release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** all production regions to v2.3.0 — verified healthy again, error rate dropped from 18% to 0.2%.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident** INC-0001 (on-call paged), documenting the failure, the rollback, and a recommendation to investigate the v2.3.1 changes before any re-deploy.

Note: if you later want to re-deploy v2.3.1 or a new fix, that will require change-manager approval since it's never been healthy in production.
